component.name: zapros
component.summary: SQL IDE for PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Oracle and SQLite
Среда для SQL: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Oracle и SQLite

description.p: zapros is a fast SQL IDE that never freezes on the network: every connection works on its own threads, and long queries can be stopped or abandoned.

ul.li: Object tree, DDL, table and job designers, Ctrl+click from the code to an object
Hints, checks while typing, a formatter with its own code style, rainbow bands for nesting
Database errors in plain words, the name underlined in the code, a guess at what was meant
Help on functions, operators and keywords on Ctrl+click
Results fetched in batches, filtered, exported to CSV, JSON, XLSX, SQL
Notebooks of SQL and Markdown cells, workspaces with their own tabs
Oracle Instant Client downloaded from the settings, no system install needed
